name: Axiom Systems Synapse Interruptor SI-3 'Stutter'
description: A pistol-format directed electromagnetic weapon that fires a precisely modulated pulse targeting the motor cortex through neural interface pathways. Targets hit by the SI-3 experience a temporary but complete disruption of voluntary motor control — muscles fire randomly, coordination collapses, speech becomes incoherent, and fine motor skills disappear for 20-30 seconds. The effect resembles a severe seizure without the associated neurological damage, though repeated exposure has been linked to cumulative motor pathway degradation. Axiom describes it as a 'motor compliance tool' in internal documentation.
specifications:
pulse type: Modulated motor cortex disruption
effective range: 3-15 meters
effect on augmented: Total motor control loss, 20-30 seconds
effect on unaugmented: Reduced — mild coordination disruption, 5-10 seconds
pulses per charge: 20
recharge: 2 seconds between pulses
weight: 0.6 kg
power source: Integrated capacitor pack
cumulative effect: Motor pathway degradation with repeated exposure
story_hooks: A security contractor has been using an SI-3 repeatedly on the same detainee during interrogation — the cumulative motor damage has left the victim with permanent tremors and the contractor is claiming standard procedure.
Modified SI-3 units have appeared that affect the autonomic motor system instead of voluntary — targets stop breathing for 20 seconds, turning a compliance tool into an assassination weapon.

Dramatic side-lighting emphasizes the angular frame geometry and the six-pointed electromagnetic emitter aperture. Slight blue glow from the capacitor indicator visible through the frame window. Neo-noir urban aesthetic: high contrast, moody blue-gray color grading, shallow depth of field, shot against textured dark metal background. Chrome accents catch the light sharply. Show the distinctive angular, almost biological profile of the muzzle flare. Include subtle electromagnetic field shimmer around the aperture. --ar 3:2 --v 6

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, angular pistol with an unusually broad muzzle assembly. The design prioritizes the electromagnetic emitter array over traditional ballistics — the front end flares outward in a distinctive hexagonal aperture, giving it an almost insectoid appearance. Chrome accents frame the muzzle while the grip tapers sharply toward the rear.
physical_description.dimensions: 22 cm overall length, 5.5 cm width at widest point (muzzle flare), 13 cm grip-to-muzzle. Muzzle aperture diameter: 4.2 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Light and front-heavy — the electromagnetic coil assembly pulls weight forward, creating an unbalanced feel in sustained aim. Approximately 600 grams total, but distributes as if heavier due to the concentrated muzzle mass.
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade aluminum alloy frame with steel reinforcement around the muzzle assembly. Capacitor housing is dense thermoplastic composite.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with brushed chrome accents around the muzzle flare. The grip area features a subtly worn polymer coating, suggesting frequent handling. Micro-scale abrasion marks visible under harsh light.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray body, polished chrome muzzle assembly, black rubberized grip. Faint blue status indicators glow faintly along the trigger guard when charged.
physical_description.grip_texture: Deeply knurled rubberized polymer with thin grooves for moisture management. Deliberately textured for secure handling even when wet. Slightly warm to touch due to capacitor proximity.
distinctive_features: Hexagonal electromagnetic emitter array at muzzle — appears as a six-pointed aperture with visible coil geometry beneath translucent housing
Blue-tinted capacitor pack visible through partial transparent window on left side of frame
Heat vents along the barrel section — crucial for thermal dissipation during rapid-fire pulses
Tiny LED status indicator (faint blue when armed) beneath the trigger guard
Axiom Systems serial plate laser-etched on the right frame — raised lettering with holographic anti-counterfeiting patch
Faint electromagnetic field distortion visible as slight shimmer around the muzzle when powered — barely perceptible but disconcerting
Wear-resistant chrome edges showing micro-scratches from holster contact
Trigger guard slightly overbuilt and reinforced — indicator of high capacitor discharge feedback
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: AXIOM SYSTEMS logo stamped on the lower left frame in anodized silver. Serial number laser-etched horizontally beneath the charging port. Small certification glyph near the trigger guard indicating Tier 3 compliance authorization.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-maintained but showing operational wear. Well-cared-for examples feature polished chrome, while enforcement units show scuffed polymer and heat-stress discoloration around the muzzle. Active-use units often have scorched residue around the aperture from electromagnetic discharge.
